quotes.text: I think that 'good taste' is much more about the ability to see and understand that simplicity — and to prefer it over cleverness.
quotes.author: Linus Torvalds

quotes.text: Your competitors will copy your features. They can't copy your taste. Build something with taste.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The indie hacker's biggest asset isn't their code. It's their taste. Build things with taste.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: "Great software is opinionated" is something I've been saying for years... And yet I have to say it so often to the teams I've worked with or managed.
quotes.author: simonbarker87
quotes.source: Hacker News — Someone behind the software
quotes.extraction_note: Core insight: opinionated software needs opinionated humans, and that's not an obvious point to teams. Trimmed the self-effacing preamble.

quotes.text: This age will be brilliant for sorting between those who care about "done" as in "technically complete" vs "done" as "creates enduring value for the person on the other end of it." AI largely only does the former.
quotes.author: kristianc
quotes.source: Hacker News — Someone behind the software
quotes.extraction_note: Sharp, non-obvious distinction about what AI actually produces — a clean lens on 'done'. Great standalone thought.
